summary: A seven-seat badge answers how a car is presented, not whether your passengers and luggage will be comfortable together. That distinction matters for the Chery TIGGO 9 Summit. Chery’s UK site identifies the TIGGO 9 Super Hybrid as a seven-seat model, while UK reviewers disagree about how useful its rearmost seats are. For a family buyer, that disagreement is a reason to arrange a realistic seating trial, rather than to choose whichever verdict sounds most reassuring.
